title: NPE thrown when creating match-all index template without explicit settings body

labels.name: Team:Data Management (obsolete)
labels.description: DO NOT USE. This team no longer exists.

**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): 
7.9.1

**Plugins installed**: 
opendistro-anomaly-detection
opendistro-job-scheduler
opendistro-knn
opendistro_alerting
opendistro_index_management
opendistro_security
opendistro_sql
repository-s3

**JVM version** (`java -version`):
openjdk version "11.0.2" 2019-01-15
OpenJDK Runtime Environment AdoptOpenJDK (build 11.0.2+9)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM AdoptOpenJDK (build 11.0.2+9, mixed mode)

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system):
Linux elasticsearch-5996669d77-6jf7k 4.14.35-1902.10.8.el7uek.x86_64 #2 SMP Thu Feb 6 11:02:28 PST 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
When attempting to create a match-all index template, i.e. `index_patterns = ["*"]`, without explicitcly defining a settings object then a NullPointerException is thrown during validation as, it seems, the validation does not take any component templates into account that the index template consists of.
It seems to be in the [PutComposableIndexTemplateAction](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/de8b39e52dc8fa4e85ddc091f38bec2123c5820a/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/admin/indices/template/put/PutComposableIndexTemplateAction.java#L99) class that the NPE is thrown as it assumes the index template has a settings object included and isn't hidden away in one of the component templates used to compose the index template.

The error is still present when testing with version 7.10.1 using the official Docker image from Docker Hub, but the error message is slightly clearer (see below)

**Steps to reproduce**:

Please include a *minimal* but *complete* recreation of the problem,
including (e.g.) index creation, mappings, settings, query etc.  The easier
you make for us to reproduce it, the more likely that somebody will take the
time to look at it.

 1. Create a component template **with** a settings object
```
curl -XPUT localhost:9200/_component_template/ctmpl1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d'
{
  "template" : {
    "settings" : {
      "index" : {
        "number_of_replicas" : "0"
      }
    }
  }
}'
```
 2. Attempt to create an index template **without** a settings object
```
curl -XPUT localhost:9200/_index_template/tmpl1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d'
{
  "index_patterns" : [
    "*"
  ],
  "composed_of" : ["ctmpl1"]
}'
```
 3. NPE is thrown
```
{
  "error": {
    "root_cause": [
      {
        "type": "null_pointer_exception",
        "reason": null
      }
    ],
    "type": "null_pointer_exception",
    "reason": null
  },
  "status": 500
}
```

4. If an empty settings object is included in the index template
```
curl -XPUT localhost:9200/_index_template/tmpl1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d'
{
  "index_patterns" : [
    "*"
  ],
  "template" : {
    "settings" : {}
  },
  "composed_of" : ["ctmpl1"]
}'
```
5. no NPE is thrown
```
{
  "acknowledged": true
}
```
